Wadephul said a Berlin coalition of the willing sends a strong signal to Moscow. Ukraine struck the key bridge to Crimea for the third time this week, intensifying pressure on the occupied peninsula. The International Court of Justice ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya is being cited as potentially relevant to Israel's genocide defence. Saudi-backed forces have responded with intensified air strikes on dozens of Houthi military sites and increased pressure on Taiz. The Houthis launched missile attacks that damaged the Saudi sovereign wealth fund headquarters and the tallest tower in Riyadh, prompting the coalition to intercept additional missiles targeting the capital and southern Saudi Arabia. Saudi Arabia dismissed its coalition commander as anti-Houthi forces pulled back from the strait and other key areas. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

The Jonglei governor reported ongoing efforts to end clashes in Bor, Duk and Twic East, and elections were postponed again to February 2027.
